headline: as_traded_close is written BEFORE the split scaling runs (order value_before_scaling): the substitution writes it at :271 and :283 inside run() call 1 (:973), the price input carrying it is written at :976-978, and the scaling (split_plan :983, apply_splits :984) comes after, on a separate cusip-keyed frame that has no basis column (:321). So a point DOES leave the build marked as_traded_close and unscaled: by construction in the price input file (every marked point there), and the price table the chain values with carries no marker at all; further paths are data-dependent (a split in neither source, an unconfirmed split, a split after the pinned instant, a run on a cash leg without the repairs).
